To automatically generate 10 or more values, select the number of values required before clicking the add button. A uniform distribution means any value between the limits is equally likely to be generated; a loguniform distribution means that values towards the lower limit are more likely.

strings.pluginname_help: Calculated questions enable individual numerical questions to be created using wildcards in curly brackets that are substituted with individual values when the quiz is taken. For example, the question "What is the area of a rectangle of length {l} and width {w}?" would have correct answer formula "{l}*{w}" (where * denotes multiplication).
strings.pluginnamesummary: Calculated questions are like numerical questions but with the numbers used selected randomly from a set when the quiz is taken.
